topic: Yuta's Copy gives the technique but his own cursed energy output limits it, shown by copied Cleave only wounding Sukuna's face
title: Why Yuta's Copied Cleave Barely Scratched Sukuna
description: Yuta Okkotsu's Copy technique looks unbeatable, but his copied Cleave only cut Sukuna's face. Here's why Copy can't beat the original user's output. Would Yuta have won with more cursed energy?
comment: Is Yuta's Copy the strongest technique in JJK, or is it only as strong as his own cursed energy?

lines.text: Yuta copied Sukuna's Cleave, and it barely scratched him.

shot.fallback: young sorcerer in white uniform swinging a slash of cursed energy

lines.text: That's the part about Copy that most fans forget.

shot.fallback: sorcerer with a giant cursed spirit behind him

lines.text: Yuta doesn't steal a technique. Rika eats a piece of the original user first.

shot.fallback: giant pale cursed spirit with long black hair

lines.text: Then Rika stores it, and Yuta can only reach it while she's out, or inside his domain.

shot.fallback: giant cursed spirit manifesting beside a sorcerer

lines.text: So everyone says Copy means Yuta gets the full technique. Here's why that's wrong.

shot.fallback: sorcerer holding a katana glowing with energy

lines.text: Cleave cuts as hard as the cursed energy you pour into it.

shot.fallback: pink haired demon king slashing with cursed energy

lines.text: Sukuna's Cleave cut straight through Ryu Ishigori's head, even with all his reinforcement.

shot.fallback: demon king slashing a giant muscular man

lines.text: Yuta's copy of the same technique only cut Sukuna's face. A small wound.

shot.fallback: sorcerer slashing a demon king across the cheek

lines.text: Same technique, same move, different engine.

shot.fallback: two sorcerers clashing in a ruined city

lines.text: So here's my read: Copy was never about borrowing power.

shot.fallback: sorcerer with a spirit looming behind him

lines.text: It's a mirror. It hands you the technique, but your own output decides how deadly it gets.

shot.fallback: sorcerer surrounded by swirling cursed energy

lines.text: That's why Yuta's copied Cleave only scratched Sukuna.

shot.fallback: young sorcerer facing a demon king in ruins
